# TopologyAware_Routing

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A routing strategy that exploits the physical layout of the interconnect topology to minimize hop count and congestion for specific traffic patterns. Essential for MoE on direct-connect topologies, as it reduces communication overhead and improves overall system throughput in TCC designs.
